# HardwareEfficientLightweightCNN

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A CNN architecture optimized for on-device inference with minimal computational and memory footprint, often using depthwise separable convolutions and pruning. Enables real-time weed identification on resource-constrained edge devices, aligning with TCC's goal of deploying intelligent processing at the network periphery.
